title: aven the framework, avenMAIA its instance
quote: Call the harness framework aven, and the instance we use avenMAIA: I talk to avenMAIA. Everything an agent session writes is authored by avenMAIA; everything human from me is authored by Samuel Andert.
means: The harness framework is aven; its instance we use is avenMAIA, the one you talk to. Every agent session writes as avenMAIA; everything human is authored by Samuel Andert.
